## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_dispatcher.py` covering the cycle_dispatcher routing branches (PASS / DISPATCH_NEXT / SHORT_CIRCUIT defensive). The DISPATCH_ARBITER branch is scoped to task 932c-13a9-8693-47b0 (arb-RED).

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4 (partial): cycle_dispatcher.next_action routing for PASS, DISPATCH_NEXT, defensive post-review SHORT_CIRCUIT.
- DD8 (partial): exit codes for PASS / DISPATCH_NEXT respecting severity gate semantics.

## Specific failing test method names

1. `test_pass_branch_exits_zero` — mock `cycle_next_action` to return `{action:'PASS', cycle_num:K}`; assert runner exits 0; assert no arbiter dispatch; assert PR comment posted summarizing zero unresolved findings.
2. `test_dispatch_next_with_blocking_findings_exits_one` — mock `cycle_next_action` returns `{action:'DISPATCH_NEXT', cycle_num:K}`; merged.findings contains a critical/important/fragile finding; assert exit 1 (severity gate fires) AND PR comment includes "Cycle K complete; N findings remain; awaiting next push for cycle K+1".
3. `test_dispatch_next_with_only_suggestions_exits_zero` — mock cycle_next_action returns DISPATCH_NEXT; findings contain only `suggestion`-severity entries; assert exit 0 (severity gate does NOT fire); PR comment still posted with cycle summary.
4. `test_defensive_post_review_short_circuit_logs_and_passes` — mock cycle_next_action returns SHORT_CIRCUIT POST-review (anomalous since pre-review check should have caught it); assert WARNING on stderr, treats as PASS (exit 0).

## Behavioral assertions

Mock `cycle_dispatcher.next_action`, `dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter` (assert NOT called for PASS/DISPATCH_NEXT), gh CLI. Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (exit codes, function-call presence/absence, PR comment body content).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 4 test methods defined with names above
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_dispatcher.py -q --co | grep -E 'test_(pass_branch|dispatch_next|defensive)' | wc -l   # expect 4
- [ ] All 4 tests fail on current main (cycle_dispatcher.next_action is not called from runner.py yet)
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_dispatcher.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAILED|ERROR)' | wc -l   # expect 4 or more
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_dispatcher.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_dispatcher.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_cycle_dispatcher.py (new, ~180 lines)
